considered: Keeping every write's Sync (rejected: a request a write); staging then Copy::push for --now (rejected: an extra ItemsList and opcore's staged warning on every --now); list --pending beside status (rejected: two homes)
author: claude-code:465b0c26-4631-5a48-93ca-bb59149c26ed:opus
cut: In Cargo.toml and src/commands.rs, use humantime’s RFC 3339 seconds formatter and delete the custom calendar conversion. In src/store.rs, sort pending metadata by timestamp before projecting it into a serializable Staged with the four status fields, then serialize that list directly in src/commands.rs instead of mapping every field again. Return the two push counts directly to their sole caller and delete the Pushed struct.
answer: Made all three: humantime::format_rfc3339_seconds replaces utc() and its test; Staged derives Serialize with secret/item/change/at and status serializes it as is; Store::push returns (sent, left) and Pushed is gone. 117 -> 86 net lines; the rest is the push and status commands, --now on three commands, and the Writes mode.
